newsitem.title: UK: British Alcan makes 50 mln stg investment.
newsitem.headline: British Alcan makes 50 mln stg investment.

text.p: Alcan Smelting & Power UK, part of British Alcan Aluminium Plc, on Thursday said it will invest 50 million stg over two years to upgrade and refurbish Potline One at its Lynemouth, Northumberland, aluminium smelter.
British Alcan is a unit of Canada's Alcan Alumnium Ltd.
The investment programme is designed to restore the plant to full capacity once market conditions allow, Alcan Smelting said.
The reopening will lead to the creation of 150 new jobs at the smelter, bringing total employment at the Lynemouth complex to over 600, the company said.
